page.layout: One page with three parallel columns of name entries, under a running head at the top; page number at top right. Column 1 (left), column 2 (centre), column 3 (right), then a large initial R and a few entries in column 3, read in order top to bottom.

main_text.l: Paldeni. | Perethker, Pertger, Pe- rithker. | Pruninc, Pruning.
Paldhun. | Perichker, Pereker, Pe- rihger. | Prunicho.
Patarih, Paterich, Pati- rih. | Pero, Peroh. | Purghart, Purcuuart, Purucuuart, Purue- hart.
Peradolt, Peradolt, Pe- rechtolt. | Peugtridi. | Quillbret.
Perahuuin. | Pirichtilo, Pirhtilo, Pi- rihtilo, Perihtilo. | Rampert, Rabret, Ram- pret, Rambret.
Perahart, Perenhart, Pernahrt, Pernhart. | Pifo. | Ramuolt.

page.notes: Column-by-column transcription of an alphabetical name index from a 16th–17th century Latin/German book. Heavy show-through and staining; several entries are uncertain and were read from a blurred scan. Lines are given as table cells separated by " | " in column order. The large R initial is joined to "Achio." and "Racholf." as printed. Some entries (e.g. "Perahoлah", "Perahtolt") are doubtful and may contain misreadings.
